response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to organize and revisit your project data. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort settings every time you open a list, you can now capture the exact configuration you need and return to it in a single click. This feature is included in all paid plans, so every subscriber can start using it right away without upgrading or paying extra. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering everything from daily task lists to quarterly reporting boards, so you can keep the setups you rely on most within easy reach. Views can also be shared with your team, making it simple to align everyone around the same filtered perspective, whether that's a sprint backlog or a client-facing dashboard. No more repeating setup steps or explaining filters over chat. Saved Views turns your most useful configurations into permanent shortcuts anyone on the team can use. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
